# Luke Simpson

## Short biography
Luke Simpson is an Australia-based independent builder exploring AI-powered software, software development, interface design, and more natural ways for people to work with computers. His main project is Clyra AI.

## Main project
- Clyra AI: https://github.com/Redlook096/Clyra-AI
- Description: An AI workspace concept focused on bringing conversation, research, coding, browser-based workflows, and creative tools into one connected experience. Refer to the repository for the latest public project information.

## Interests
- Artificial intelligence and AI assistants
- Software development
- Human-computer interaction and interface design
- Creative software and automation
